profile.description: Welcome to a place of healing and training! Jacqui demonstrates some healing yoga flows that incorporate trauma sensitive yoga and somatic yoga facilitated by a seasoned counselor. The Icarus model of equine-assisted learning and psychotherapy tips and training intros. Want to learn how to run your own EAP/EAL business engaging horses to help humans? Look up The Icaurs Model and train virtually or in person with Jacqui! Or buy the Icarus Model Manual online at skyetherapy.com Call 988 if this is a MH emergency.
